pages.text: Gas Pipes carry $(l)gas$() (biogas, methane, Steam and the gases of other mods) from the machines that make it to the machines and tanks that use or store it. $(l)Liquids$() such as water and coolant need a $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l) instead.

$(li)Pipes $(l)connect by themselves$() to other Gas Pipes and to any block that holds fluids, from CyberFarm or any other mod.$(br)$(li)All three tiers join into one network.$(br)$(li)A Gas Pipe never joins a Liquid Pipe, so a water line and a steam line can run side by side.
pages.title: Placing

pages.text: $(li)To empty a $(l:cables/fluid_tanks)Gas Tank$(/l) into a machine, $(l)right-click the pipe's arm$() that touches the tank so it pulls (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)).
$(li)Pipes $(l)store nothing$(): what a machine pushes in goes straight to the blocks on the network, which take turns.$(br)$(li)The sleeves have $(l)green lights$().
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: $(li)While a gas flows you can see it in the glass, see-through with puffs drifting along. When the flow stops, the pipe looks empty again.$(br)$(li)Where a line branches, bends or ends, the glass becomes a small framed cube.

The rate is how much gas can enter the network per tick from each machine pushing in, set by the pipe that touches it.$(br)$(li)$(l)Gas Pipe$(): grey, 1,000 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Gas Pipe$(): gold, 4,000 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Gas Pipe$(): violet, 16,000 mB/t
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: The steam of a Large reactor needs Advanced pipes. To upgrade a line already in place, use the $(l:cables/cable_swapper)Cable Swapper$(/l).
